policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy. Referenced from Decisions via obligation.policy_id and from §9 policy(p).

scope_paths.description: Glob patterns of paths this policy applies to. See spec/algebra-3.2.md §9.

obligations.description: Obligations that bind any Decision touching scope_paths (direct) or transitive_into paths (transitive).

mode_floor.description: Minimum assurance mode required for any Decision touching this policy. See spec/algebra-3.2.md §3, §9.

transitive_into.description: Paths that inherit this policy's obligations via data flow (imports/exports reachability). See spec/algebra-3.2.md §9 transitive_paths.

data_flow_edges.description: Inferred or declared data-flow edges between paths. The transitive closure drives transitive_paths(c). See spec/algebra-3.2.md §9.
